say.en: India started a national family planning programme in 1951; today the wider programmes are called Reproductive and Child Health Care, RCH.
Reproductive health means total well-being in all aspects of reproduction: physical, emotional, behavioural and social.
The strategies: awareness through media, sex education in schools, care of mothers and babies, and equal value for boys and girls.
In amniocentesis a needle draws amniotic fluid; foetal cells in it show the chromosomes. It is meant to find genetic disorders.
Because it was misused to find the sex of the foetus and abort girls, India has a legal ban on amniocentesis for sex determination.

body.en: Amniocentesis is a foetal sex-determination test based on the chromosomal pattern in the amniotic fluid surrounding the developing embryo. It is meant to detect genetic disorders, but it was misused to find the sex of the foetus and abort female foetuses. India has a statutory ban on amniocentesis for sex determination, to curb female foeticide. Better awareness has reduced maternal and infant mortality and increased medically assisted deliveries.
